comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: This week's delivery item for part of the Solar Barge is the Greek goddess amulet. I think the non-Chrono quest Statue of an ancient Greek god works best as you talk once in Salonika, finish the quest in Southwest Salonika relatively close to the gates, and then are free to drop the amulet off in Benghazi on your way back to your capital, assuming you're not an Ottoman, I suppose.
